Parent issue: #71. This bounded follow-up stays blocked until its parent packet is merged and its dependencies are complete.

For exactly these 19 assigned Greek ADM3 subjects, resolve candidate crosswalks from the pinned geoBoundaries 2010 layer to ELSTAT 2021 Kallikratis census units. Include multi-unit intersections for Samos and Lesbos, inspect exact codes and neighboring granularity, clarify CC0 versus CC BY 3.0 input-license metadata, and seek an authoritative administrative/legal boundary and identity source. ELSTAT census geometries are not legal boundary evidence. Preserve old/new IDs and vintage; do not select largest-overlap transfers or modify geography.

Acceptance: investigate actual source roles, parent relationships, boundaries, vintage, completeness, license and adjacent granularity. Retain lawful original evidence or explicit restoration instructions, exact whole-file hashes and retrieval dates. Give an individually sourced outcome for every assigned subject and preserve identities, releases and other workers' evidence. State unresolved gaps honestly. Research/evidence only: no production data, publishing, region approval or historical import.
